objections.claim: The test requires observing SWA layer classification in at least two distinct models with known SWA configurations, but no such models or data are provided in the sources. The claim that the classification occurs only when the mask shows the window is conditional and unverified in practice; it is a logical assertion from the release note, not an observed outcome.
objections.quote: When cache extents match, classify the larger mask group as SWA only once its mask has fewer keys per row than the other mask. Keep the classification per KV cache buffer so new sequences reuse the same graph, and include swa_layers when checking graph reuse.

objections.claim: The test requires observing FA mask broadcasting over Q batch dimensions in a test case with non-uniform Q batch sizes. However, the release note labels this a 'CI fix' and does not describe any measurable impact on inference behavior or data handoff. No evidence exists that this change improves consistency in attention masking during research data processing.
objections.quote: webgpu: (fix CI) allow the FA mask to be broadcast over the Q batch (#32535)

objections.claim: The obstruction correctly identifies that the commit is a repository snapshot, not a published release, and runtime access is untested. The test requires observing correct handling of non-contiguous views, but no test case or verified inference behavior is available. The claim that 'strided kernel_clamp_nc' exists is not independently verified.
objections.quote: The clamp kernel indexed source and destination as one flat contiguous array, so a strided view as input (the new CLAMP v=1 case) read the wrong elements. Add a strided kernel_clamp_nc, as the other unary ops have, and take it whenever the source is not contiguous.

objections.claim: The test requires measuring data handoff fidelity in CPU-only inference and comparing it to a trusted baseline. However, no baseline is defined, and no evidence exists that CPU-only inference improves data handoff fidelity. The change described in S3 is unrelated to data handoff or transferability.
objections.quote: CUDA: use MMQ for MoE on V100 (#32504)
